WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day,
         COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film
  WHERE rental_duration > 5
  GROUP BY rating
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS overall_benchmark
  FROM per_rating
)
SELECT p.rating,
       p.avg_rate_per_day,
       p.film_count,
       p.avg_rate_per_day / b.overall_benchmark AS benchmark_ratio
FROM per_rating AS p
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE b.overall_benchmark IS NOT NULL
